1. Solve \( n^2 > 10 \):
\[ n > \sqrt{10} \quad \text{or} \quad n < -\sqrt{10} \]
Since \( \sqrt{10} \approx 3.162 \), the smallest integer \( n \) can be is 4 (since \( n \) must be greater than \( \sqrt{10} \)).

2. Solve \( n^2 < 99 \):
\[ n < \sqrt{99} \quad \text{or} \quad n > -\sqrt{99} \]
